reviews.comment: She is a very kind and funny professor, though can be unorganized at times. The class is based mostly on a group project, some essays, and a few easy quizzes over a singular book you have to buy. There is an off-campus experience at the end of the semester... but it's a lot of fun!

I love Dr. Passmore so much. Participating and doing the work are extremely important, but she creates an environment in which you WANT to do the work. She's kind of scatter brained, but it adds to the fun experience honestly and doesn't detract from the course. Highly recommend.

The class was interesting and not difficult. We wrote 2 responses to articles we read throughout the semester and then a final paper at the end, which unfortunately never got graded. We had one news presentation as well. She's a tough grader but as long as you follow the general idea you'll do well.
